item.title: Poetry by the Bay — Thu Nov 26, 7:00 PM — Mira Theatre Guild
item.description:
Poetry By The Bay is a free spokenword open mic event in Vallejo, CA. Since 2008 we've welcomed and encouraged artists to express who they are and grow as a person and an artist in a safe space.
Join us every 4th Thursday of the month at Mira Theatre. Sign the sign up list for time on the stage.
We don't know what others will share so be open minded and aware that adult content may be discussed.
Donations are appreciated to help support the forces behind the scenes that make it all possible. Enjoy the Show & Keep Writing.

The Harvest Market is a great place to pick up produce, flowers, and eggs harvested from our 6.1 acre sustainable garden. We will be selling products such as fresh produce, eggs from free-range chickens, honey, and olive oil. The market now accepts credit cards. Remember to bring your reusable shopping bag!
To stay updated on our events, sign up for our newsletter at: sonomaecologycenter.org/newsletters-sign-up

item.description: Sit & Stitch on every Monday 3:30 and 5:30 PM. You can drop in for any amount of time. We will also have tea, so bring your favorite covered drink container. Sit and Stitch is for people to come and work on any fiber arts activity that they have while visiting with others. Most people will bring their own projects, but we always have hooks, needles, and yarn and sometimes we will offer a project with instructions that people may choose to make. Let us know what you would like to learn this year. We now have a working sewing machine for people to use. For beginners, I will bring is some fabric to make pillowcases. If you have a project that you would like to work on, bring in your fabric and thread and you can use the machine. We share ideas, skills, and encouragement with each other. item.title: Petaluma Children's Business Fair — Sat Dec 5, 11:00 AM — The Spring Hill School
item.description:
Come support the next generation of entrepreneurs at the Children’s Business Fair!
Young entrepreneurs from across Sonoma and Marin Counties will bring their business ideas to life, creating products, developing their brands, setting prices, and selling directly to customers at this one-day marketplace.
More than a market, the fair is a hands-on learning experience designed to build creativity, confidence, financial literacy, and real-world business skills. Throughout the day, local business leaders and entrepreneurs will visit student booths, offering encouragement, practical advice, and feedback to help kids think and grow like business owners.
Come shop, discover unique kid-created products, and support the next generation of local entrepreneurs!
Interested in launching your own business? Children from throughout Sonoma and Marin Counties are invited to participate.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

Celebrate the season at the Arts Guild of Sonoma, voted Best Art Gallery in Sonoma in the 2026 People's Choice Awards. Discover original art ranging from traditional to contemporary works, with Featured Member Artist Pat Meier-Johnson's oils and pastels capturing Northern California life. Join the December 5 reception during Sonoma's citywide Sip and Shop and browse handmade ornaments and unique holiday gifts, jewelry, ceramics, glass, sculpture, cards. item.title: Dirty Cello at Mac's at 19 Broadway — Sat Dec 5, 8:00 PM — Mac's at
item.description:
'Tis the season to hear way too much holiday music!
Join the band Dirty Cello for an evening of wild blues, rock and Americana with little to know Christmas music. Give your ears a break from Mariah Carey, and come out for some Zeppelin, Stevie Ray, and Rolling Stones.
The band Dirty Cello plays all over the world from Iceland to Singapore and they love performing in their hometown of Marin County. Join this world traveling band for a special show at Mac’s at 19 Broadway.
On Dec 5 at 8 pm, Dirty Cello will perform a concert of wild rock and roll, soulful blues and irreverent originals performed with high energy abandon. The group has been described by the L.A. Times as, "The group seamlessly careens from blues to bluegrass and rock in a way that really shouldn't make sense but somehow does."
Mac’s at 19 Broadway opened in 1926 and has turned from a dive bar into an upscale prohibition-style lounge.
Tickets are available at the door, but pre-bought tickets are preferred.
Source: P

item.title: Santa Paws - Pictures with Santa for Dogs and Cats — Sun Dec 6, 11:00 AM — Barber Lee Spirits
item.description:
Santa is at the distillery, and he's taking pictures with dogs and cats. Bring yours to Barber Lee Spirits Distillery on Sunday, December 6, from 11 am to 2 pm. Cats may have opinions about this. Bring them anyway.
The event is in partnership with Sage Compassion for Animals, a Bay Area nonprofit that helps families pay for veterinary care when a pet is in a medical crisis. When a dog or cat needs emergency treatment and the bill is more than a family can cover, SageC4A steps in so the pet gets care and stays home with the people who love it. They also teach pet owners how to prevent illness before it becomes an emergency.
A portion of the day's proceeds goes to that work. SageC4A will be on site to answer questions, with a donation jar and QR codes if you'd like to give more.
Barber Lee makes spirits, but there's also wine, non-alcoholic drinks, food, chocolate, and cheese. Kids are welcome. Stay a while.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Native Plant Garden Volunteer Day — Fri Dec 11, 9:00 AM — Laguna Environmental Center
item.description:
Share Your Passion for Pollinators—Join Us in the Garden!
Join the Laguna de Santa Rosa Foundation for a volunteer morning in our 4-acre Native Plant Demonstration Garden at the Laguna Environmental Center! Help keep this beautiful garden thriving while connecting with community and nature.
Volunteers help with planting, pruning, weeding, and spreading wood chips while caring for a diverse landscape of native wildflowers, grasses, trees, and more. Enjoy special garden features like a living willow tunnel, tranquil pond, scenic bridge, and observation deck.
No experience necessary—we provide training, tools, and snacks! Wear clothes you don't mind getting dirty. Only heavy rain cancels.

item.title: Loma Vista Farm Christmas Tree Sales — Sat Dec 12, 10:00 AM — Loma Vista Farm
item.description:
Santa will be a the Farm on Sunday, November 29, from noon to 2 p.m.
Fresh Noble Fir, Douglas Fir, Nordman Firs and Poinsettias available for purchase at the Farm staring November 27, every Saturday and Sunday from 10 AM to 4:30 PM until all sold.
Pick up your tree in person, or you can arrange to have it delivered. Trees can also be purchased online at https://lomavistafarm.org/shop
Loma Vista Farm is a five-acre outdoor classroom in North Vallejo that provides children with hands-on educational activities with plants and animals. All proceeds from the sale will go toward animal care and improvements to the farm.
